mapper.select: SELECT FF.FOLDER_CODE, FF.PARENT_CODE, FF.FOLDER_NAME, FF.SORT_ORDER, FF.REG_USER, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), FF.REG_DATE, 120) AS REG_DATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FILE_ATTACH FA WHERE FA.FOLDER_CODE = FF.FOLDER_CODE) AS FILE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FILE_FOLDER SUB WHERE SUB.PARENT_CODE = FF.FOLDER_CODE) AS SUB_FOLDER_COUNT FROM FILE_FOLDER FF ORDER BY ISNULL(FF.PARENT_CODE, 0), FF.SORT_ORDER, FF.FOLDER_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FILE_FOLDER (PARENT_CODE, FOLDER_NAME, SORT_ORDER, REG_USER, REG_DATE) VALUES (#{parent_code,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{folder_name}, #{sort_order}, #{reg_user}, GETDATE())
mapper.select: ;WITH FolderTree AS ( SELECT FOLDER_CODE FROM FILE_FOLDER WHERE FOLDER_CODE = #{folder_code} UNION ALL SELECT f.FOLDER_CODE FROM FILE_FOLDER f INNER JOIN FolderTree t ON f.PARENT_CODE = t.FOLDER_CODE ) SELECT FOLDER_CODE FROM FolderTree

;WITH FolderTree AS ( SELECT FOLDER_CODE FROM FILE_FOLDER WHERE FOLDER_CODE = #{folder_code} UNION ALL SELECT f.FOLDER_CODE FROM FILE_FOLDER f INNER JOIN FolderTree t ON f.PARENT_CODE = t.FOLDER_CODE ) SELECT FA.FILE_CODE, FA.FOLDER_CODE, FA.ORIGINAL_NAME, FA.SAVED_NAME FROM FILE_ATTACH FA WHERE FA.FOLDER_CODE IN (SELECT FOLDER_CODE FROM FolderTree)
mapper.delete: ;WITH FolderTree AS ( SELECT FOLDER_CODE FROM FILE_FOLDER WHERE FOLDER_CODE = #{folder_code} UNION ALL SELECT f.FOLDER_CODE FROM FILE_FOLDER f INNER JOIN FolderTree t ON f.PARENT_CODE = t.FOLDER_CODE ) DELETE FROM FILE_ATTACH WHERE FOLDER_CODE IN (SELECT FOLDER_CODE FROM FolderTree)

;WITH FolderTree AS ( SELECT FOLDER_CODE FROM FILE_FOLDER WHERE FOLDER_CODE = #{folder_code} UNION ALL SELECT f.FOLDER_CODE FROM FILE_FOLDER f INNER JOIN FolderTree t ON f.PARENT_CODE = t.FOLDER_CODE ) DELETE FROM FILE_FOLDER WHERE FOLDER_CODE IN (SELECT FOLDER_CODE FROM FolderTree)
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_CODE, FOLDER_CODE, ORIGINAL_NAME, SAVED_NAME, FILE_SIZE, REG_USER, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), REG_DATE, 120) AS REG_DATE FROM FILE_ATTACH WHERE FOLDER_CODE = #{folder_code} ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FILE_ATTACH (FOLDER_CODE, ORIGINAL_NAME, SAVED_NAME, FILE_SIZE, REG_USER, REG_DATE) VALUES (#{folder_code}, #{original_name}, #{saved_name}, #{file_size}, #{reg_user}, GETDATE())
